name: muefs
description: Michigan Unified E-Filing System — monorepo scripts

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && ruff check app/ tests/
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && mypy app/ && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.install:all: cd backend && python -m pip install -e ".[test]" && cd ../frontend && npm install
